messages:
nora_sre: Quick sprint-checkin for the postmortem action items around GPU tail-risk and autoscale. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth. Short bullets please.

ashley_platform: I'll own the burst-smoothing admission controller and staggered warmup tests. Running two staging passes today (A/B).

devon_scheduler: I'll file the quota-escrow PR for dedicated us-west. Proposal: +4 GPUs staged (+2 now, +2 after 10 days). Draft PR by Fri.

maria_capacity: I'll run headroom sims with the latest traces (including partner syncs at 03:00 UTC). Plan to deliver CSV + cost delta by Wed EOD.

ben_oncall: Ops will publish a 1-pager emergency scale runbook and add a Slack workflow to trigger the warmup job. ETA: tomorrow morning.

priya_finance: Please include a 30-day run-rate and monthly delta in the PR so finance can fast-track approval if needed.

lina_partnership: I'll prepare partner comms in case we recommend shifting sync windows; will only send with Maria's sim numbers.

infra-bot: Created INF-7001: "Burst-smoothing experiment" (owner: ashley_platform) | due 2024-08-02

nora_sre: Owners & dates agreed: scheduler experiment @ashley_platform due 2024-08-02, quota PR @devon_scheduler due 2024-08-04, headroom sims @maria_capacity due 2024-07-31, ops playbook @ben_oncall due 2024-07-30, finance review @priya_finance due 2024-08-06, partner comms @lina_partnership due 2024-08-07.

ashley_platform: Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 36h, health gates: 99th latency regression <5%, error rate <0.5%. Will paste canary job link after first run.

maria_capacity: Early sim notes: smoothing + 1 pre-warm GPU reduces 99th tail by ~20% during batch spikes. Full report & cost model uploading to internal drive.

devon_scheduler: PR will include staged grant + escrow expiry + alert rules for headroom <22%. Tagging @priya_finance in the PR.

ben_oncall: Runbook snippet added to ops-playbooks. Manual emergency scale example:
```
/ops/warmup start --pool=dedi-us-west --units=2
kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=inference -n redwood --timeout=300s
```
Also added Slack shortcut to kick warmup.

nora_sre: Two follow-ups for the next check-in: 1) Maria to attach the 30-day cost comparison (pre-warm vs quota increase); 2) Ashley to post canary logs and AB results. We'll reconvene here in 5 days. Thanks all."
